summary_en: Interim dividend per share raised from 11 yen to 12 yen for the fiscal year ending February 2027, effective November 9, 2026. Year-end dividend also increased from 11 yen to 12 yen, bringing full-year dividend to 24 yen per share, in response to upward revision of full-year earnings forecast.
title_en: Notice Regarding Surplus Dividend (Interim Dividend Increase) and Revision of Dividend Forecast
translation_en_brief:
On October 8, 2026, Yoshinoya Holdings' board of directors resolved to increase the interim dividend for the fiscal year ending February 2027 from the previously forecasted 11 yen per share to 12 yen per share, with an effective date of November 9, 2026. The total dividend amount is 768 million yen, sourced from retained earnings.

Simultaneously, the company revised its year-end dividend forecast upward from 11 yen to 12 yen per share. As a result, the total annual dividend for fiscal year ending February 2027 is now projected at 24 yen per share, compared to the previously forecast 22 yen per share.

The increase reflects the company's upward revision of full-year earnings guidance, which the board determined justified higher shareholder distributions while maintaining financial stability. The company maintains a basic policy of providing stable profit returns to shareholders by comprehensively considering consolidated business performance, financial condition, and reserves necessary for future operations.
